description: Requires Errand 0.4.2 or later. Reviews job execution (any operand-bearing invocation) and `fetch --apply`; flag-only and help invocations remain automatic. Conservative port of the v1 detector: declarative matchers cannot exclude known read-only subcommands, so operand-bearing calls like `errand ps` also review.
name: Errand
saferAlternatives: Inspect jobs with errand ps or errand status HANDLE before executing or applying changes.
Stage retained changes with errand fetch HANDLE before applying them.
